messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: Service=redwood-inference-gateway-prod · Alert=HTTP_5XX_RATE_HIGH · Urgency=high · 1m 5xx_rate=6.2% in us-west1 :rotating_light: https://pd.redwood/alerts/PD-AB12CD

oncall-jordan: acked — i'm on. brief? any deployments in the last 30m?

incident-bot: Recent deploy: deploy-bot @ 02:05 UTC (gateway v3.8.1-canary, weight 10%) · top signals: kvcache_miss=17% · sidecar_conn_reset=spike · region breakdown: us-west1=6.2%, eu-west1=0.4%

alex: seeing a lot of `502 connection reset by peer` from sidecar proxies in us-west1. client retries > 3k in 5m. not all pods, looks correlated with canary slice.

tess: running quick logs grep across us-west1 (tail last 12m):
```bash
kubectl -n prod logs -l role=gateway -c sidecar --since=12m | grep -E "502|connection reset|timeout" | head -n 50
```

maggie: i'm going to drop canary weight to 0% (traffic-slice) and scale down concurrency until we stabilise. will update when done.

oncall-jordan: do it. also follow runbook '5xx-surge -> throttle & warm caches' steps. set concurrency env to 20 on gateway replicas in us-west1.

alex: applying concurrency change now (targeted to us-west1 cluster):
```bash
kubectl --context=us-west1 -n prod set env deploy/gateway CONCURRENCY=20 --record
```
applied, pods are restarting.

maggie: canary weight set to 0% — confirmed by traffic console.

incident-bot: system note: routing fallback active for 6 nodes, traffic re-routed to stable variant.

tess: after rollback and throttle, 5xx rate dropped to 1.4% in the last 2m. still watching for regressions.

oncall-jordan: good. start cache warmup for popular prefixes (runbook step 3). alex, can you prime KV cache for /v1/generate hot keys?

alex: kicking off a targeted warmup job: `kubectl run cache-warm-01 --image=tools/warm:latest -- ...` — job started. I'll monitor success counts.

cs-amy: customer-facing update: CS queue shows ~12 distinct customer reports (mostly 502s) starting ~02:06 UTC. I'll open an incident banner and message affected customers after we have a stable mitigation.

maggie: monitoring dashboards show error budget dip but no SLO breach yet. p50 latency unchanged, p99 improved slightly after rollback.

oncall-jordan: leaving a note for postmortem: investigate change in sidecar behavior with canary build v3.8.1-canary, and kvcache miss patterns. Also confirm whether batching or kernel changes could increase sidecar memory pressure.

deploy-bot: rollback completed: gateway -> v3.8.0-stable in us-west1 (automated rollback executed).

incident-bot: PD note: incident acknowledged by oncall-jordan · Escalation suppressed to next tier (soft-ack) · Keep thread updated.

alex: error rate back down to 0.9% across us-west1 at 02:29 UTC. warmup show hit-rate rising to 82% on hot prefixes.

cs-amy: sent initial customer note to affected users: "We experienced elevated errors from 02:05–02:25 UTC. Service restored; follow-up will include root cause and timelines." :white_check_mark:

noncall-jordan: handing off to day-sre for full RCA — tagging @maggie for lead. I'll update incident page and set follow-up meeting. great job everyone. :thumbsup:

maggie: will run targeted regression tests against canary in staging and check sidecar release notes. saving logs and flipping retention to 24h for this thread.

incident-bot: Thread closed for oncall; action items: (1) RCA + timeline, (2) revert canary promotion workflow until tests pass, (3) tighten PD thresholds for sidecar connreset spikes.

cs-amy: noted, will follow-up with customers once RCA draft ready.

oncall-jordan: final — incident resolved, status: mitigated. moving to postmortem.
